example.title: Bridge on PWF Road over Sicily Creek (abandoned)
example.place: west of SW 32 Rd, rural Gage County, NE
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Sicily Creek PWF Rd bridge (Gage County, Nebraska))

brief: Small riveted steel Pratt pony truss on an abandoned section of a gravel section-line road: channel end posts and top chord with riveted gusset plates at the hips, angle verticals and diagonals, steel floor beams under a transverse plank deck with longitudinal running planks, on timber/steel pile abutments. Now derelict, deck planks rotting and the whole span swallowed by trees and vines over a muddy creek. Model it in service: plank deck, low truss as the only rail. (Date not given; early 20th century.)
